# Jordan Electric

Jordan Electric is an electrician based in Newberry, FL, serving homes and businesses across Alachua County with residential electrical services, commercial electrical services, generator installation, and electrical service calls and repairs.

- Licensed: Florida electrical contractor license EC 13016035 (verify at https://www.myfloridalicense.com/wl11.asp)
- Founded: 2026, with over 20 years of hands-on electrical experience behind the company
- Management: family-managed

## Services
- Residential Electrical Services: complete residential electrical services for homeowners across Alachua County, including new construction wiring and panel upgrades
- Commercial Electrical Services: electrical solutions for businesses that support daily operations and future growth
- Generator Installation: generator systems that provide reliable backup power when it is needed most
- Electrical Service Calls & Repairs: troubleshooting and repair for both residential and commercial properties

## About
Jordan Electric is a family-managed electrical contractor based in Newberry, FL, established in 2026 on more than 20 years of hands-on electrical experience. The company handles new construction wiring, panel upgrades, commercial electrical work, generator installation, and service calls and repairs in Newberry and across Alachua County.
